The clash between NEOM and Al Ittihad marks an exciting encounter in the Saudi Arabia - Pro League calendar. As the year draws to a close, both teams are looking to solidify their standings and end 2025 on a high note. NEOM, striving to rise in the league table, will face a formidable opponent in Al Ittihad, a team that has been in impressive form lately. Head coach Juan Carlos Osorio is under pressure to find the right tactical setup to exploit Al Ittihad's defensive vulnerabilities. The team will be eager to harness home advantage and rally their fans to produce a memorable performance.

On the other side, Al Ittihad has emerged as one of the Pro League's top contenders this season, bolstered by a mix of seasoned players and young talent. Manager Nuno Espírito Santo has instilled a winning mentality within the squad, which has translated into a robust attacking style and resilient defense. Ittihad has been on a winning streak, and they will aim to continue this momentum as they visit NEOM.

NEOM has struggled defensively, often conceding goals in crucial moments that have cost them points. In attack, they have shown potential through their creative midfield, but consistency remains an issue. The team recently welcomed back key striker Mohamad Madayi from injury, who could provide the spark they need upfront. Expect NEOM to adopt an aggressive approach, pressing high to force mistakes from their opponents.

Al Ittihad boasts a strong defensive record, having conceded the fewest goals in the league thus far. Their attack is led by experienced forward Abderrazak Hamdallah, who has been in stellar form this season. Recent addition to the squad, midfielder Taison, adds depth to their fluid transitioning and playmaking capabilities.
